info.name: Field Service System API
info.description: Complete API collection for the Field Service System. Run Register/Login first to save the access and refresh tokens as collection variables, then run each folder in flow order: Services -> Service Requests (Customer creates, Manager approves/rejects) -> Work Orders (view by all roles; Customer sees only own, Technician only assigned) -> Assignments (Manager creates a PENDING offer; Technician accepts/rejects via /accept or /reject — accepting assigns the work order, rejecting leaves it CREATED) -> Service Visits (Schedule, Technician Arrives/Starts, Work Completed; Customer can view own visits) -> Service Reports (Technician files one per COMPLETED work order) -> Invoices (Manager issues; Manager/Technician add cost items) -> Payments (initiate via /payments/initiate or /payments/:invoiceId/pay, then bKash redirect/webhook) -> Feedbacks (Customer reviews the completed + paid work order) -> Admin (users, roles, dashboard stats, audit logs). Users can read/update their own profile at /users/me. The core resource is exposed at /resources (CRUD + search + soft delete + assign/status/cancel/my-assigned). Completing a visit auto-completes the work order. Resource IDs are captured automatically via test scripts. Applicants register as customers, apply via Technicians -> Apply as Technician, then an Admin/Manager approves or rejects. Attachments (Customer uploads photos against their own Service Request, Technician attaches before/after photos to their assigned Work Order) are handled under Attachments.

item.name: Users
item.description: Authenticated user profile. GET /me returns the current user with customer/technician profile. PATCH /me updates shared fields plus role-specific profile fields.

item.name: Technicians
item.description: Apply as a technician (PENDING) then Admin/Manager approves (user becomes TECHNICIAN) or rejects. Includes technician profile CRUD.

item.name: Services
item.description: Admin/Manager only (except Get All Services), authenticated with accessToken.

item.name: Service Requests

body.raw:
{
  "title": "AC not cooling properly",
  "description": "AC compressor was not working properly",
  "preferredDate": "2026-09-20T10:00:00.000Z",
  "address": "House 12, Road 5, Dhanmondi",
  "city": "Dhaka",
  "district": "Dhaka"
}

item.description: Customer: create/update/delete own requests. Manager/Admin: review all requests and approve or reject; approving auto-generates a work order.

item.name: Attachments
item.description: File uploads (images/documents/other) linked to a Service Request or a Work Order. Files are stored on Cloudinary and only fileName, fileUrl and type are kept in the database (see Attachment model). A Customer attaches photos to their own request, a Technician attaches before/after photos to their assigned work order, and a Manager/Admin can attach/view/delete any. POST expects multipart/form-data with a file field plus optional requestId/workOrderId (at least one) and an optional type (IMAGE | DOCUMENT | OTHER; auto-detected from the MIME type when omitted).

item.name: Resources
item.description: Core resource = ServiceRequest. Full CRUD + search, soft delete, manager business operations (assign, status), customer cancel, and technician my-assigned. Existing /api/v1/request routes remain as aliases.

item.name: Work Orders
Update Work Order Status (CREATED -> CANCELLED, Admin/Manager)

item.description: View by all authenticated roles (Customer sees only own via their Service Request, Technician sees only assigned). PATCH /status by Admin/Manager only and only CREATED -> CANCELLED.

item.name: Assignments
item.description: Create by Admin/Manager (creates a PENDING offer against an existing work order), view by Admin/Manager/Technician (technician sees only own). The technician accepts or rejects the offer; accepting assigns the work order (status ASSIGNED) and auto-rejects other pending offers, rejecting leaves the work order CREATED. Delete by Admin/Manager (cannot delete an ACCEPTED assignment once the work is started).

item.name: Service Visits
Complete Visit (IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED, work order auto-COMPLETED)

item.description: Create/Delete by Admin/Manager; status updates by Technician. SCHEDULED -> IN_PROGRESS (technician arrives / work started) -> COMPLETED (marks the work order COMPLETED).

item.name: Service Reports
item.description: Created/updated by the assigned Technician against a COMPLETED work order (one report per work order). View by Admin/Manager/Technician (technician sees only own).

item.name: Invoices
item.description: Create/Update/Delete by Admin/Manager, view by Admin/Manager/Customer. Amount is auto-calculated as Service Price + (actualCost ?? estimatedCost ?? 0) + sum of additional cost items unless an explicit amount is sent. Admin/Manager/Technician can add extra bill line items (e.g. purchased parts, extra labor, transport) via POST /:invoiceId/items and remove them via DELETE /:invoiceId/items/:itemId — the invoice amount is updated automatically. Technicians can only add/remove costs on work orders assigned to them, and only while the invoice is DRAFT or ISSUED. Authenticated with accessToken.

item.name: Payments

exec: console.log('Open this URL in a browser:', response.data.paymentUrl);

item.description: bKash payment flow. Customer pays an issued invoice (POST /:invoiceId/pay returns a bKash payment URL to open in the browser). The bKash redirect callback is public. Admin/Manager lists all payments; Customer lists their own via /my. Customer can only view their own single payment.

item.name: Feedbacks
item.description: Service reviews. Only a Customer can submit feedback (POST /), and only after the work order is COMPLETED and its invoice is PAID. Rating is 1-5 and each work order can be reviewed once. The technician is attached automatically from the work order.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin operations: list users, change a user role, dashboard stats (counts + revenue + avg rating), and audit logs (system change tracking).

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Read-only analytics made from existing data (no new CRUD). Admin/Manager: customers, technicians, services, requests, work orders, completed orders, pending requests and total revenue. Technician: assigned work orders, pending assignments, today's visits and completed work orders. Customer: own service requests, pending requests, active work orders, completed services, total and paid invoices.
